verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents fine-grained role-based access control, including the ability to restrict who can modify production environments, so the roles-and-permissions part of the story is covered. Nothing in the evidence describes scoped API tokens; the only key mentioned is a public, non-secret Environment Key. Per-flag (rather than per-environment) permission granularity is also not shown. missing for 10: scoped/permissioned API tokens, explicit per-flag permission granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration of RBAC.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens

citations.quote: Role-based access control (RBAC) provides fine-grained access management of Flagsmith resources.
Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.
Using RBAC, you can ensure users only have the access they need within your Flagsmith organisation.
